timed_region: Three sequential local intervals cover time-delay and form-factor computation (roomsim/roomsim.cpp:876-882), propagation (888-893), and distance computation (899-904). Their millisecond durations are summed at line 910.
start_synchronization: Each local phase starts before its numerical work. Cross-rank start synchronization is unnecessary because every process independently computes a complete result.
stop_synchronization: The OpenMP parallel-for constructs have implicit completion barriers and no nowait clauses. Precomputation and propagation return only after their host threads finish; sequential distance computation returns before endDist. The actual computation contains no CUDA launches or asynchronous device operations, so device synchronization is unnecessary.
rank_aggregation: None, and none is required under the complete-result replica rule. Each process owns the full simulation state, computes every matrix row, every timestep and every output distance, and does not consume numerical work from another rank.
reported_value: Every process prints its own complete compute-only totalTime using 'Total computation time: %ld ms' at roomsim/roomsim.cpp:911. The value is the sum of the three correctly converted local millisecond durations.
semantic_equivalence_basis: Complete-result replication is established by ownership and loop bounds: each process initializes full N-by-N and T-by-N arrays; computes time delays and form factors for all i,j; propagates all T timesteps over all receivers and emitters; and computes distances for all N triangles using its own radiosity history. Output uses the entire local distances vector. MPI initialization and finalization provide no numerical dependencies. Thus another process's earlier start or later completion does not invalidate this replica's complete local measurement; no global-makespan equivalence is claimed.

evidence.finding: Initialization constructs the complete mesh, initializes every triangle's area, allocates full simulation arrays, and supplies the source emission locally.
Both precomputation routines cover every i and j from zero to numTriangles. No MPI rank partition is applied. Their OpenMP parallel-for regions complete before return.

Propagation covers every timestep, every receiver i, and every emitter j, reading local tau, kij and radiosity and writing every local radiosity row. Each parallel-for completes before the next timestep.
Distance computation covers every triangle and all correlation lags using the complete local radiosity history, producing the entire distances vector synchronously.
Every process enters the same argument-parsing path after MPI_Init. Validation and output options only set flags; they do not select another computation implementation.

Each process creates its own state, initializes it before timing, brackets all three intended computation phases, converts each interval to milliseconds, and prints their sum under the canonical label.

Optional result output consumes the entire local distances vector. Validation occurs after all computation and timing; MPI_Finalize also follows the printed total. Neither supplies missing numerical work.
